reviewer: Codex independently compares source, nodes, labels, directions and qualifiers; not a human review

checks.quote: 先整理需求，再制作原型，然后邀请三位用户试用。
checks.criterion: 需求→原型→三人试用先后
checks.evidence: r0/r1 retain requirements -> prototype -> three-user trial.

checks.quote: 试用中出现的困难会形成问题清单，问题清单用于修订需求，修订后的需求再进入下一轮原型制作。
checks.criterion: 困难→清单→修订需求→下一轮原型完整循环
checks.evidence: r2/r3/r4/r5 retain trial difficulties -> list -> requirements revision -> next-round prototype; r6/r7 explicitly characterize repetition rather than a one-off line. Return is textual, not a geometrically closed cycle.

checks.quote: 若问题涉及操作步骤，小组优先简化步骤；若问题仅涉及文字看不懂，可以先修改提示语。
checks.criterion: 操作问题简化步骤、仅文字问题可改提示两条件分开
checks.evidence: r8/r9 distinguish operational-step difficulties from text-only difficulties, retain priority and optionality.

checks.quote: 两种处理针对不同问题，不要求先改步骤再改提示语。
checks.criterion: 无强制两处理先后关系
checks.evidence: r10 explicitly says different issues and no required order; n18 repeats the constraint.

checks.quote: 修改完成后需要再次试用；仅完成修改不能证明问题已经解决。
checks.criterion: 修改→再试用，修改不足以证明解决
checks.evidence: r11 requires repeat trial; r12 modification alone cannot prove resolution.

checks.quote: 只有再次试用未发现同一问题且三位用户都确认理解时，小组才把该问题标记为已解决。
checks.criterion: 未发现同问题且所有三人确认共同条件
checks.evidence: n24 keeps no recurrence AND all three users confirming together; r13 only then marks solved.

checks.quote: 原型制作中可以暂缓与本轮问题无关的装饰设计，
checks.criterion: 可暂缓无关装饰，非所有设计都禁止
checks.evidence: r14 allows deferring only decorative design unrelated to current issues.

checks.quote: 但不能删掉尚未解决的问题记录。
checks.criterion: 不能删除未解决问题记录
checks.evidence: r15 prohibits deleting unresolved problem records.

issues.finding: 两种处理针对不同问题 — 并且 → 不要求先改步骤再改提示语 is a sentence-splitting pseudo relation between two already complete statements. It duplicates the valid r10 constraint and is not a useful source-backed concept relation. Model review approved it despite the no-duplicate-sentence rule.

readability_notes: 8 frozen checks are covered, but an additional invalid edge means the whole map is not independently accepted.
Loop is stated through next-round wording; a clear return connection would improve visual comprehension.
scope: Frozen check coverage and additional full-edge review; one output is not a population accuracy estimate
